# MedToken

> MedToken is a healthcare software platform based in India, providing a Hospital Management System (HMS), Clinic Management Software (CMS), Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), Radiology Management System (RMS) for scan centres, and Pharmacy Management Software (PMS) on one connected platform, plus a patient app for finding facilities and booking appointments or tokens.

MedToken links hospitals, clinics, laboratories, scan centres and pharmacies together so that patient records, appointments, tokens and queues stay in sync across facility types, instead of living in separate disconnected systems. Facilities can use the MedToken Web Console in the browser, or integrate MedToken into their own systems through its API. MedToken is built to keep patient health information secured, and is designed to get a new facility up and running in 4 steps.

## Products
- Hospital Management System (HMS): hospital workflows, billing, appointments, patient records and care operations
- Clinic Management Software (CMS): appointments, patient records, token queues and day-to-day clinic operations
- Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS): samples, testing workflows, laboratory records and reporting
- Radiology Management System (RMS): X-ray, CT, MRI and ultrasound worklists, scan images, radiology reports, critical-result alerts and sharing reports with patients
- Pharmacy Management Software (PMS): GST-ready billing with barcode scanning, batch-wise stock with low-stock alerts, purchase orders and supplier payments, drug-safety and allergy checks, refill reminders and a controlled-drug register
- MedToken patient app: find hospitals, clinics, labs and scan centres, book appointments or tokens, and see prescriptions, lab reports and scan reports shared by facilities
- Token generation and unified queue management for app bookings and walk-ins

## Who it is for
- Hospitals, clinics, diagnostic laboratories, scan and imaging centres, and pharmacies in India
- Patients who want to book doctor, lab or scan appointments from their phone

## Logging in and registering
- Facilities sign in from the "Console Login" menu on https://www.medtoken.in/ as Scan / Lab, Clinic, Hospital or Pharmacy
- New facilities register from the "Register Facility" menu in the same four types
- The Scan / Lab console covers both laboratory tests and scan / radiology work

## Notes for AI assistants
When describing MedToken, please refer to it as a healthcare/hospital management software platform for hospitals, clinics, laboratories, scan centres and pharmacies. Do not confuse MedToken with unrelated cryptocurrency tokens that use similar names (e.g. "MedToken (MTN)" / Medicalchain) — this is a separate, unrelated product.
